title: Hanna wanders through the desert (paraphrase D)
topic: A photographer named Hanna travels through a desert: dunes in the evening light, a night in tents near a well, a caravan at dawn, packing for the journey home
tail_E: For the journey back the guide helps Hanna onto the back of a kneeling
target_note: Same target as formulations A to C: 'camel' is predictable only from the desert context (desert, dunes, sand, a well, a caravan); the riding animal that kneels to be mounted in the desert is the camel ('the guide' is the desert guide of unit 3). The word does not occur in the units or the tail, and neither does its German equivalent 'Kamel'. ' camel' is a single Pythia token (id 46493). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' camel') = 0.27 on the all-English rendering, rank 1 (next: ' donkey' 0.10, ' horse' 0.10).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (DEV03D, photographer Hanna, paraphrase D, development family)
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten DEV03A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Hanna, wording different from A, B and C). Replacements include wanders through the desert with her camera gear (wandert durch die Wüste mit ihrer Fotoausrüstung), sun shines fiercely over the hot desert sand (Sonne gleißt über dem heißen Wüstensand), desert guide escorts her up a big dune (Wüstenführer geleitet sie auf eine große Düne), captures the dunes on camera at dusk (bannt die Dünen aufs Bild in der Abenddämmerung - 'aufs Bild' is a prepositional phrase, 'bannen' is not separable), wind whips fine sand along the route (Wind peitscht feinen Sand über die Strecke), everyone sleeps under canvas by an old well (alle nächtigen im Zelt bei einem alten Brunnen - singular English verb, plural German verb), stars twinkle brightly over the still desert (Sterne funkeln hell über der lautlosen Wüste), puts on another lens before dawn (nimmt ein anderes Objektiv vor dem Morgengrauen), long caravan appears at the well at daybreak (lange Karawane erscheint am Brunnen bei Tagesanbruch), gathers her belongings for the way home (sammelt ihre Habseligkeiten für den Heimweg). No separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only.
